meta.title: Hidden Edge - 1
meta.description: Facing the foe head on can be a wise strategy too.

units.rawText: Somewhere in the Null Area, the purplish-black Entropic hordes are churning. Suddenly, a flare of white light off to the side carves away part of the darkness and cuts open a path.
units.displayText: Somewhere in the Null Area, the purplish-black Entropic hordes are churning. Suddenly, a flare of white light off to the side carves away part of the darkness and cuts open a path.

spans.text: Somewhere in the Null Area, the purplish-black Entropic hordes are churning. Suddenly, a flare of white light off to the side carves away part of the darkness and cuts open a path.

units.rawText: Hundreds of eyes look at that white radiance, transmitting the image to their leader.
units.displayText: Hundreds of eyes look at that white radiance, transmitting the image to their leader.

spans.text: Hundreds of eyes look at that white radiance, transmitting the image to their leader.

units.rawText: So the lead doesn't intend to show themselves, but plans to leave it to a knight instead?
units.displayText: So the lead doesn't intend to show themselves, but plans to leave it to a knight instead?

spans.text: So the lead doesn't intend to show themselves, but plans to leave it to a knight instead?

units.rawText: Hehe... Even if you've been selected as the lead, such behavior will only lead to others scorning you. Or are you saying this is how you intend to build your character?
units.displayText: Hehe... Even if you've been selected as the lead, such behavior will only lead to others scorning you. Or are you saying this is how you intend to build your character?

spans.text: Hehe... Even if you've been selected as the lead, such behavior will only lead to others scorning you. Or are you saying this is how you intend to build your character?

units.rawText: That just won't do... I suppose I'll have to use the knight's blood to remind the lead that "you have to be a hero."
units.displayText: That just won't do... I suppose I'll have to use the knight's blood to remind the lead that "you have to be a hero."

spans.text: That just won't do... I suppose I'll have to use the knight's blood to remind the lead that "you have to be a hero."

units.rawText: Meanwhile, Faith leads the mixed force of Sanctifiers and the Oasis agents as they fight through the sea of Entropics and engage in secret communications.

spans.text: Meanwhile, Faith leads the mixed force of Sanctifiers and the Oasis agents as they fight through the sea of Entropics and engage in secret communications.

units.rawText: Professor <cmdr>, according to the results of previous scans, Odile should be nearby.
units.displayText: Professor {교수}, according to the results of previous scans, Odile should be nearby.

units.rawText: We've cleared the surrounding area and successfully drawn their fire. Please use this opportunity to find Odile's hiding place.

units.rawText: Faith, a large pack of Entropics is headed this way.
units.displayText: Faith, a large pack of Entropics is headed this way.

spans.text: Faith, a large pack of Entropics is headed this way.

units.rawText: Understood, I will lead a team to intercept them. I'll be counting on you for the infiltration.
